post.caption:
Build the URL before the agent. 📮

Postman against an ASP.NET Core API: spicy=true&maxPrice=20. Three dishes in 11 ms.

A Microsoft Foundry agent is just a caller. It picks the parameters a person would have typed and reads the same JSON. If the URL is wrong, the failure arrives dressed as an AI problem.

So: Minimal API, SQL Server, EF Core migration, seed data, a test per method. Then hand the URL to the agent.

Full article: blog.msdevbuild.com/blog/aspnet-core-api-food-delivery-agent-backend

Follow for AI engineering tips.
